qs.s: Le ___ humain est composé de plusieurs systèmes.
qs.en: The human body is composed of several systems.

qs.en: She takes care of her body by doing sports.

qs.s: Les ___ ont été retrouvés dans la forêt.
qs.en: The bodies were found in the forest.

qs.s: Le ___ est le temple de l'esprit selon certains philosophes.
qs.en: The body is the temple of the mind according to some philosophers.

qs.en: We discovered a lifeless body in the abandoned house.

qs.en: She joined the French diplomatic corps.

qs.en: The soldiers of the army corps fought bravely.

qs.en: Headlong, he threw himself into the river.

qs.en: The teaching profession/body advocates for better working conditions.

qs.en: For this project, I need quality textile material.

qs.s: ___ première dont parlait le professeur était très complexe.
qs.en: The first subject that the professor was discussing was very complex.

qs.en: The grey material that he bought at the market is perfect for the dress.

qs.en: In French, we are studying several interesting subjects this term.

qs.s: ___ brutes de la région attirent les entreprises industrielles.
qs.en: The raw materials from the region attract industrial companies.

qs.en: Physics studies the matter that makes up the universe.

qs.en: It is an excellent subject to discuss the social problems of our time.

qs.s: Il y a ___ de réjouissance dans cette victoire.
qs.en: There is cause for rejoicing in this victory.

qs.s: Le chimiste analyse ___ pour découvrir ses propriétés.
qs.en: The chemist analyzes the matter to discover its properties.

qs.en: We have much cause to complain about this situation.
qs.form: singular, feminine (idiomatic: avoir matière = to have cause/reason)

qs.s: En ___ de droit, je ne suis pas expert.
qs.en: As for matters of law, I am not an expert.
qs.form: singular, feminine (en matière de = idiomatic phrase)

qs.s: L'enfant est nourri au ___ de sa mère avec naturel.
qs.en: The child is breastfed naturally.

qs.s: Elle a nourri ses trois enfants au ___ pendant deux ans chacun.
qs.en: She breastfed her three children for two years each.

qs.s: À la Renaissance, les artistes ont étudié l'anatomie du ___ avec grande attention.
qs.en: In the Renaissance, artists studied the anatomy of the breast with great attention.

qs.s: Les déesses antiques sont souvent représentées avec ___ exposés.
qs.en: Ancient goddesses are often depicted with exposed breasts.

qs.en: Within the company, decisions are made collectively.

qs.s: Au ___ de la famille, il a toujours trouvé du réconfort.
qs.en: In the bosom of his family, he always found comfort.

qs.s: Au ___ de la forêt équatoriale vivent des milliers d'espèces méconnues.
qs.en: Within the equatorial forest live thousands of unknown species.

qs.en: Within parliament, political tensions have been accumulating for months.

qs.en: The midwife examined the breast to ensure that breastfeeding was proceeding correctly.

qs.s: Au ___ du groupe de recherche, trois nouveaux projets ont été lancés.
qs.en: Within the research group, three new projects have been launched.

qs.en: I encountered considerable difficulty during my exam.

qs.en: The main difficulty of this project is the lack of budget.

qs.s: Il n'y a aucune ___ à comprendre cette règle.
qs.en: There is no difficulty in understanding this rule.

qs.s: Les ___ augmentent au fur et à mesure du projet.
qs.en: The difficulties increase as the project progresses.

qs.s: Des ___ administratives ralentissent le processus.
qs.en: Administrative difficulties slow down the process.

qs.en: We overcame the difficulty together.

qs.en: Learning a language presents many difficulties (challenges).

qs.en: Despite the financial difficulty (hardship), they succeeded.

qs.en: The communication difficulties between the two teams create issues.

qs.s: Face à cette ___ inattendue, nous avons dû changer notre stratégie.
qs.en: Facing this unexpected difficulty (obstacle), we had to change our strategy.

qs.en: We have difficulty agreeing on this subject.
qs.form: partitive article in 'éprouver de la difficulté à' construction

qs.s: Elle a surmonté ___ avec courage et persévérance.
qs.en: She overcame the difficulty with courage and perseverance.

qs.s: Parler en public ne présente aucune ___ pour lui.
qs.en: Speaking in public presents no difficulty for him.

qs.s: Les ___ d'apprentissage de ses enfants le préoccupaient.
qs.en: The learning difficulties of his children worried him.

qs.s: Malgré toutes les ___ rencontrées, il n'a jamais abandonné.
qs.en: Despite all the difficulties encountered, he never gave up.

qs.en: After years of intensive study, I hope to reach this director position.

qs.s: Tu ___ à tes objectifs professionnels grâce à ton dévouement.
qs.en: You reach your professional goals thanks to your dedication.

qs.en: He finally manages to understand the difficult mathematical concept.

qs.s: Nous ___ à résoudre ce problème en collaborant ensemble.
qs.en: We manage to solve this problem by working together.

qs.s: Vous ___ à vos ambitions malgré les obstacles.
qs.en: You all achieve your ambitions despite the obstacles.

qs.s: Ils ___ progressivement à une meilleure compréhension du sujet.
qs.en: They gradually reach a better understanding of the subject.

qs.en: I managed to reach the summit after a long difficult climb.

qs.s: Mon collègue ___ à terminer le projet avant la deadline imprévue.
qs.en: My colleague managed to finish the project before the unexpected deadline.

qs.s: Nous ___ à conclure un accord commercial avantageux.
qs.en: We managed to reach an advantageous business agreement.

qs.s: Les étudiants ___ à maîtriser la langue étrangère après un an d'étude.
qs.en: The students managed to master the foreign language after a year of study.

qs.en: When I was young, I used to reach my goals easily without much effort.

qs.s: Nous ___ rarement à garder notre secret longtemps.
qs.en: We rarely used to manage to keep our secret for long.

qs.s: Vous ___ toujours à communiquer efficacement malgré la barrière linguistique.

qs.s: Ils ___ constamment à négocier des conditions favorables.
qs.en: They constantly used to manage to negotiate favorable conditions.

qs.en: Tomorrow, I will manage to finish this important report.

qs.en: You will doubtless manage to solve this complex puzzle.

qs.s: Il ___ certainement à atteindre son rêve s'il persévère.
qs.en: He will certainly manage to achieve his dream if he perseveres.

qs.s: Nous ___ à construire une solution durable pour ce problème environnemental.
qs.en: We will manage to build a sustainable solution for this environmental problem.

qs.s: Vous ___ finalement à convaincre les autorités d'approuver le projet.
qs.en: You will finally manage to convince the authorities to approve the project.

qs.en: The researchers will manage to discover the vaccine we are waiting for.

qs.en: If you worked harder, you would manage to achieve your academic goals.

qs.en: With more resources, we would manage to improve the quality of service.

qs.s: Il ___ facilement à ce poste s'il avait une meilleure formation.
qs.en: He would easily achieve this position if he had better training.

qs.s: Je doute qu'il ___ à comprendre cette théorie complexe rapidement.
qs.en: I doubt that he will manage to understand this complex theory quickly.

qs.s: Il est important que tu ___ à te concentrer sur tes études.
qs.en: It is important that you manage to concentrate on your studies.

qs.s: Bien que nous ___ à progresser, nous avons encore beaucoup à apprendre.
qs.en: Although we manage to progress, we still have a lot to learn.

qs.s: Il faut que vous ___ à trouver une solution avant vendredi.
qs.en: You must manage to find a solution before Friday.

qs.s: Après des années de persévérance, elle est finalement ___ à devenir avocate.
qs.en: After years of perseverance, she finally managed to become a lawyer.

qs.s: Les alpinistes sont ___ au sommet de la montagne malgré les conditions difficiles.
qs.en: The mountaineers reached the summit of the mountain despite difficult conditions.
